sources.title: [26.19] 😈 GNARZ'S GUIDE TO BECOME THE BEST EVELYNN 😈

passive.name: Demon Shade
passive.text: When out of combat, Evelynn enters Demon Shade. Demon Shade heals Evelynn when she is low on health and grants Camouflage after level 6.

spells.name: Hate Spike
spells.text: Evelynn strikes out with her Lasher, dealing damage to the first unit hit. Then, Evelynn can shoot a line of spikes at nearby foes a few times.

spells.name: Allure
spells.text: Evelynn curses her target, causing her next attack or spell after a delay to charm her target and reduce their magic resist.

spells.name: Whiplash
spells.text: Evelynn whips her target with her Lasher, dealing damage. She then gains Move Speed for a short duration.

spells.name: Last Caress
spells.text: Evelynn briefly goes untargetable and decimates the area in front of her before warping backwards a long distance.

damage.value: Evelynn deals burst-oriented magic damage, with Sudden Impact adding true damage.

archetype.value: Evelynn plays as an assassin, using Camouflage to approach, Allure to charm, and Last Caress to escape.

spikes.why: Evelynn gains camouflage, so stealth wards no longer see her.
Evelynn gains Camouflage in Demon Shade after level 6.

bait.why: After Evelynn spends Allure, its 15-to-11-second cooldown leaves her without its charm and magic-resist reduction.
After Evelynn spends Last Caress, its 120-to-80-second cooldown leaves her without its untargetability and backward warp.

mistakes.value: Evelynn gains little from keeping Oracle Lens after level 6 because camouflage already hides her from stealth wards.
Evelynn is a weaker draft choice when her team is entirely AP.
